security-fix (inline, coordinator finding: cleanDeep key collision)
review (inline self-review of the full diff)
inlineNote: The session was capped at 2 concurrent agents, so every stage ran inline in the lane agent: no harness-planner, harness-task-executor, harness-verifier, harness-code-reviewer or parallel code-review agents were dispatched. advise_skills (SKILLS.md) and harness-soundness-review were not run as tools; the spec was self-reviewed instead.
closingKeywordWhy: The issue's acceptance is one command that gives a developer mid-change fast, advisory test guidance composed from existing skills, with the five design questions settled first. This PR answers all five in the spec (membership, gap analysis as a composition, working-diff trigger with a 5 s budget, advisory with exit 3 only on abstention, #607 as the spine) and ships the skill. It is not a slice.
assumptions: No human was available: the brainstorming EVALUATE questions were settled by the maintainer's lane decisions (D1, D2, D6, D8, D9) or by the recommended option (D3, D4, D5, D7), recorded in the spec.

D2 tension: ADR 0009 says advisory commands exit 0 on abstention; the maintainer chose exit 3 for this advisory skill. Precedent: canary history gaps. The gate-conformance registry row type gained an optional advisoryCode and an optional strict to express it.
D3: members run in process by importing canary-katana, canary-savant and canary-blackhawk exports (precedent: canary-unquarantine imports katana modules), not by spawning their CLIs.
D4: 5000 ms default budget checked between members; 200-file target clamp; 25 Markdown rows per section.
D5: default branch is origin/HEAD's target, else origin/main, main, origin/master, master; none resolving falls back to uncommitted changes against HEAD, noted in the brief.
Q2 answered as a composition (critical-areas map x katana ties), so no new analysis engine and no park.
canary-cassandra left out of membership: suite-audit shaped and it delegates to ts/dist.
No slash command or Gemini command added for the new skill (no skill.yaml); it is invoked through canary skills run and the plugin skill listing.
Sibling SKILL.md boundary lines changed canary-pr-guardian and canary-test-pipeline, so their generated Gemini commands were regenerated with scripts/gemini-commands-drift.mjs --write.
Coordinator security finding (cleanDeep key collision) fixed test-first: colliding cleaned keys are suffixed ~2, ~3 and never overwrite; keys clamp at the JSON limit.
Parentheses are not escaped in Markdown output: a link needs a preceding ], which is always escaped.

The CLI was split into cli -> run -> brief -> members -> scans so no module imports more than four others; the first cut added a coupling finding to members.mjs and cli.mjs (perf 202 against a 201 ceiling).

Ratchets measured in clean detached worktrees of ea020e5e (base) and the head: perf 200 -> 200 (delta 0, ceiling 201); entropy 100 -> 100; arch module-size 61500 -> 61501 (+1, agents/skills/vitest.config.ts coverage include; .mjs is outside the aggregate), newViolations 0; docs coverage 140/517 -> 143/526, floor OK.
The only harness.config.json edit is the cli.mjs entry in both entropy.entryPoints and performance.entryPoints.
